config.uniform: N as u32, padded to 16 bytes
config.serialProtocol: Each pass completes query and correctness readback before the next submission; no overlapping samples
config.setup: Pipeline once per run; buffers, bindings, uniform and input upload once per configuration outside sampling loops
config.gpuBoundary: Compute pass timestampWrites beginningOfPassWriteIndex/endOfPassWriteIndex; nanoseconds; includes possible pass scheduling costs
config.wallBoundary: performance.now immediately before queue.submit to onSubmittedWorkDone completion; includes submitted pass, query resolve and buffer copies, excludes subsequent mapping and CPU correctness
config.batching: Repeated dispatches overwrite the same C; cache and resource dependencies may affect time; no division into independent kernel latency
config.statistics: Measured passes only; all zero values retained; median midpoint for even count; nearest-rank p95 = sorted[ceil(0.95*n)-1]; min/max; zero count
config.interpretation: No strict N monotonicity requirement; no bottleneck or peak bandwidth inference; not a formal GEMM benchmark
